label: Wall Panel Control
info:
Maps a Zigbee remote to wall-panel INTENTS.

On import, set this flow's zigbee2mqtt-in topic to YOUR remote's IEEE
address and point both MQTT nodes at your own authenticated broker config.

  arrow_right_click -> wallpanel/command = next
  arrow_left_click  -> wallpanel/command = prev
  off               -> wallpanel/command = blank
  on                -> wallpanel/override = "" (retained) - resume schedule

This flow deliberately contains NO view names. The shell (views.js) owns the
view list and resolves next/prev/blank against it at runtime, so adding a view
never requires touching or re-importing this flow.

'on' clears the retained override directly rather than going through the
shell, so resuming the schedule still works while the panel is offline.

name: map button -> intent
